# Geoff Chan

> AI product engineer and ex-founder. Head of Product & Engineering at Jain, building AI that helps building service contractors bid and price their work. Previously Head of Product & AI at Raven, building agentic systems end to end for manufacturers. Founded Stack Five (a boutique product agency, bootstrapped to ~$1M in revenue) and led a 16-person engineering team at Code4rena.

## About

- [Homepage](https://geoffreychan.com/): Short bio, current work at Jain, professional history, links.
- [Resume](https://geoffreychan.com/resume/): Detailed career timeline.

## Experiments and projects on this site

- [Grant Connect for Claude](https://api.grantconnect.ca/mcp/docs): MCP connector for Canadian fundraisers to research funders in Claude, built for Imagine Canada.
- [Magnet World](https://github.com/geoffchan23/magnet-world): Godot magnetic-tile building game made with my son.
- [Unstable Unicorns](https://geoffreychan.com/unicorns/): Unofficial online version of the card game.
- [Tokens](https://geoffreychan.com/tokens/): Live Claude Code token usage from my smart-home agent, updated hourly.
- [Conferences](https://geoffreychan.com/conferences/): Agent-curated, high-signal software engineering conference calendar with an AI engineering bias. Filterable by region and topic.
- [Art](https://geoffreychan.com/art/): Sketchbook and personal art.
